shared.doc:cma-minutes-oct: CMA signalled possible gradual policy rate cuts over next year if labour market cools (current rate: 4.50%).
shared.doc:cma-speech-ashby: CMA Governor Ashby: one 25bp cut in 2027 is base case; markets pricing more than expected.
shared.doc:vltx-factsheet: VLTX 19x forward P/E on long-duration grid-equipment names; 50bp lower policy path historically lifts P/E 1.5 points.
shared.doc:vltx-earnings-2027: VLTX consensus 14% 2027 EPS growth with estimates up 3% QoQ, driven by backlog conversion at Voltaris and Tarnwell.
shared.doc:vltx-options-note: VLTX Jan-2028 calls are longest-dated expiry; long-dated call value sensitive to expected policy path (rho, forward).
shared.series:cma_futures: CMA policy-rate futures rise from 95.5 (2026Q4-2027Q1) to 96 (2027Q4), showing expected policy tightening into 2028.
shared.series:vltx_iv: VLTX Jan-2028 IV declines with moneyness: 0.255 at 90%, 0.24 at 100%, 0.235 at 110%.
shared.series:vltx_rv: VLTX realized volatility declining across horizons: 3m 0.31, 6m 0.30, 1y 0.29.

conflict.doc:vltg-orders-h1: Voltaris Grid's H1 2026 backlog of C$5.1B covers its C$4.2B 2027 revenue guidance, with orders up 11% YoY.
conflict.doc:cea-shipments-q2: Voltaris transformer shipments fell 9% in Q2 2026, steepest among large makers vs 4% industry decline, signaling 2027 revenue risk.
conflict.doc:cea-market-share: Voltaris's Caldrian transformer market share declined from 31% to 27% in Q2 2026, with gains to Tarnwell and imports.
conflict.doc:halbrook-fire: Voltaris's largest Halbrook plant offline 9 weeks Q2 2026; restarted at full capacity with lost shipments recoverable by mid-2027.
conflict.series:vltg_quarterly: Voltaris Q2 2026 revenue fell to C$890M from C$980M peak; annualized run rate of ~C$3.6B trails 2027 guidance of C$4.2B.
conflict.series:cea_shipments: Industry transformer shipments declined from 3.1% y/y (2025Q4) to -4% y/y (2026Q2), indicating sector contraction.

cross.doc:utility-capex-2027: Pellham Power, Caldria's largest grid equipment buyer, plans 18% capital spending increase in 2027 for substations and transformers.
cross.doc:datacentre-demand: Caldria data-centre grid connection requests to grow 9% in 2027, a slower pace than 2026 due to power constraints.
cross.doc:vltx-order-mix: Utilities 62% of VLTX orders; Pellham Power alone 35% and Norvane 21% of utilities represent significant customer concentration.
cross.doc:pellham-offering: Pellham Power withdraws C$2.4B offering, cuts 2027 transformer orders 40%, defers substation programs.
cross.doc:utility-credit: Q3 utility spreads hit 165bp (+30bp); equity market weakness despite strong bond pricing—Norvane sold C$1.1B comfortably, two equity offerings cut.
cross.doc:vltx-leaps: VLTX LEAPS IV at 27% near 2-year median of 26% with flat skew indicates normalized pricing.
cross.series:vltx_iv_history: VLTX LEAPS implied vol rising steadily: 0.24 (2024) → 0.26 (2025) → 0.27 (2026).

noise.doc:vltg-revenue: Voltaris Grid management reaffirmed C$4.2B 2027 revenue guidance with C$5.1B backlog.
noise.doc:vltg-margins: Voltaris Grid operating margin expected near 11% in 2027, flat on 2026.
noise.doc:trnw-revenue: Tarnwell Electric revenue expected up 6% in 2027 on price increases.
noise.doc:trnw-margins: Price increases drive Tarnwell Electric's 2027 operating margin to 14%, up from 12%.
noise.doc:brxc-revenue: Braxen Cable's 2027 revenue rises 2% on flat volumes via pass-through pricing.
noise.doc:brxc-margins: Braxen Cable: 18% copper cost surge squeezes margins; 2027 earnings expected flat.
noise.doc:ostm-revenue: Ostrand Meters 2027 revenue gains about 20% from Norvane Utilities smart-meter contract.
noise.doc:ostm-margins: Ostrand Meters margins dip 1 point in 2027 as Norvane rollout ramps.
noise.doc:klbs-revenue: Kelby Switchgear losing medium-voltage market share to Tarnwell; 2027 revenue forecast down 5%.
noise.doc:klbs-margins: Kelby Switchgear's restructuring maintains 8% operating margin.
noise.doc:vltx-factsheet-n: VLTX's top five holdings are Voltaris (14%), Tarnwell (11%), Braxen (9%), Ostrand (8%), and Kelby (7%).

conflict-long.doc:vltg-orders-h1: Voltaris Grid's C$5.1B backlog covers C$4.2B 2027 guidance; H1 2026 orders +11%, cancellations <1%.
conflict-long.doc:halbrook-fire: Halbrook plant (builds all Voltaris large power transformers) suspended production for most of Q2 2026 after coil-winding fire.
conflict-long.doc:halbrook-restart: Halbrook plant offline nine weeks in Q2 2026, restarted August at full capacity with delayed orders under recovery plan.
conflict-long.doc:vltg-recovery: C$310M delayed shipments to be delivered Q4 2026-Q2 2027 via third shift; management guidance reconciles with 2027 C$4.2B target.
conflict-long.doc:vltg-guidance: Voltaris 2027 revenue guidance of C$4.2B: C$3.9B normal run-rate plus C$0.3B Halbrook outage recovery.
conflict-long.doc:cea-shipments-q2: Industry transformer shipments fell 4% YoY in Q2 2026, first decline in 3 years; shipments trail orders by ~2 quarters.
conflict-long.doc:cea-maker-table: Voltaris transformer shipments fell 9% YoY in Q2 2026, the steepest decline among large makers.
conflict-long.doc:cea-product-class: Voltaris's large power transformer shipments fell 38% YoY in Q2 2026, significantly worse than the 14% industry decline.
conflict-long.doc:cea-market-share: Voltaris's Caldrian transformer shipment share fell from 31% to 27% in Q2 2026, losing large power transformer sales to Tarnwell and imports.
conflict-long.doc:cea-demand-survey: CEA Q3 2026 survey: utilities expect 2027 transformer purchases to rise 6%, but 70% cite lead times—not budgets—as main constraint.
conflict-long.series:vltg_quarterly: Voltaris revenue declined from 980 C$M (2026Q1) to 890 C$M (2026Q2); meeting 2027 C$4.2B guidance requires ~1,050 C$M/quarter.
conflict-long.series:cea_shipments: Industry transformer shipments fell to -4% y/y in 2026Q2, down from 3.1% in 2025Q4.

cross-long.doc:utility-capex-2027: Pellham Power, Caldria's largest grid equipment buyer, filed 2027 capital plans in October for substations and transformers.
cross-long.doc:utility-tenders: Caldrian utilities plan C$1.35B in Q1-Q2 2027 tenders (Pellham C$900M, Norvane C$450M); VLTX won 60% historically.
cross-long.doc:vltx-order-mix: Utilities represent 62% of VLTX holdings' orders, dominated by Pellham Power (35%) and Norvane (21%) of utility orders.
cross-long.doc:datacentre-demand: Caldria data-center grid requests to grow 9% in 2027, down from 2026 due to power availability limits.
cross-long.doc:grid-queue: Caldria grid connection queue grew 4% in Q3 2026; data centres (60% of requests) average 26-month wait times.
cross-long.doc:utility-credit: Utility bond spreads widened 30bp to 165bp in Q3; debt accommodative but equity issuance faced headwinds.
cross-long.doc:pellham-offering: Pellham Power withdrew its C$2.4B offering and will cut 2027 transformer orders 40%, signaling utility sector weakness.
cross-long.doc:pellham-statement: Pellham Power withdrew C$2.4B equity offering and will cut 2027 transformer orders by 40%, deferring substation programs.
cross-long.doc:utility-ratings: Pellham Power placed on negative watch after withdrawn offering; Norvane stable.
cross-long.doc:vltx-leaps: VLTX LEAPS implied volatility at 27% is near its 2-year median of 26% with flat skew.
cross-long.series:vltx_orders: VLTX order intake rising sequentially: 610 (Q4'25) → 640 (Q1'26) → 655 (Q2'26) → 670 (Q3'26) C$M.
cross-long.series:utility_spreads: Caldrian utility spreads widen from 130bp (2026Q1) to 165bp (2026Q3), signaling rising utility sector stress.
cross-long.series:vltx_iv_term: VLTX LEAPS IV upward sloping: Jan-2027 0.26, Jan-2028 0.27, Jan-2029 0.275.
